properties.name: Hutan Bagelen
properties.note: Dense teak and bamboo forests west of Bogowonto, classic insurgent sanctuary.

properties.name: Alas Roban
properties.note: Perilous forested coastal pass between Batang and Weleri on the Great Post Road.

properties.name: Wana Menoreh
properties.note: Rugged karst ridge forests sheltering Prince Diponegoro's mountain headquarters.

properties.name: Hutan Lereng Merapi
properties.note: Pine and montane forest on the southern and eastern volcanic flanks of Merapi.

properties.name: Alas Lodoyo
properties.note: Vast wilderness south of the Brantas river, legendary home of the white tiger.

properties.name: Alas Jati Grobogan
properties.note: Ancient royal teak forests producing timber for Mataram and VOC shipbuilding.

properties.name: Wana Jati Blora
properties.note: Dense teak plantations along the middle course of Bengawan Solo.

properties.name: Alas Donoloyo
properties.note: Sacred teak forest in Slogohimo Wonogiri planted in the Majapahit era.

properties.name: Hutan Serayu Banyumas
properties.note: Riverine and foothill forests flanking the lower Serayu valley.

properties.name: Wana Kedu
properties.note: Orchard and teak groves of the fertile Kedu plain between Sumbing and Merapi.

properties.name: Hutan Pegunungan Kendeng
properties.note: Dry deciduous limestone ridge forest forming a natural boundary in eastern Central Java.

properties.name: Alas Purwo
properties.note: Ancient mystical jungle covering the easternmost peninsula of Java.

properties.name: Hutan Wilis
properties.note: Highland pine and moss forest on the massif dividing Madiun and Kediri.

properties.name: Wana Gunung Semeru
properties.note: Cloud forest covering the upper slopes of Mount Semeru and the Tengger range.
